method.controlModel: Per event/channel fit constant307Hz sine+cosine+DC to preceding1024original control samples; freeze those3coefficients; predict suspect and neighboring blocks without refitting them.
method.comparisons: Compare unshifted serial phase with deliberate -256,-128,+128,+256sample phase alternatives; exact prior-block equality and one-sample boundary steps independently checked.
method.limits: Periodic control can reject these128sample duplicate/skip hypotheses, not prove deck/WASM cursor, all possible phase-equivalent faults, renderer scheduling cause or source clock correctness.

pairs.conclusion: Both independent control channels continue phase in received serial order. The duplicated timestamp does not duplicate prior control PCM; following timestamp skip does not skip128control samples under the fitted307Hz model.
